query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS warehouse_bays (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  sqft INTEGER NOT NULL,
  price_per_sqft_per_day DECIMAL(10,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.50,
  is_available BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) * 1000
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_warehouse_bays_available ON warehouse_bays(is_available);

-- Seed with 6 default bays
INSERT INTO warehouse_bays (name, sqft, price_per_sqft_per_day, is_available, notes) VALUES
  ('Bay A1', 200,  0.45, TRUE, 'Ground floor, forklift accessible, 14ft clearance'),
  ('Bay A2', 200,  0.45, TRUE, 'Ground floor, forklift accessible, 14ft clearance'),
  ('Bay B1', 400,  0.40, TRUE, 'Large bay, suited for oversized robots, 20ft clearance'),
  ('Bay B2', 400,  0.40, TRUE, 'Large bay, suited for oversized robots, 20ft clearance'),
  ('Bay C1', 100,  0.55, TRUE, 'Climate-controlled, sensitive electronics, 10ft clearance'),
  ('Bay C2', 100,  0.55, TRUE, 'Climate-controlled, sensitive electronics, 10ft clearance')
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
